text: The fn tab opens this panel over the tool (Help → Function explorer does the same); the grid keeps its size.
Search by name or by what a function does.
Every function a mapping can call. The grey tag tells whether it is built in or from a file of the project (fn/…).
The signature and what it returns.
Insert puts the call in the cell, or the override, you are editing; Edit… (or Override… on a built-in) opens the editor.
New function… adds a stub function to a file of the project, or to a new one.
